- Real bootstrap/scan dump: grep -c 'compaction snip' ≥1 on an L1-processed result + a result processed ≥2× has byte-identical 1st==2nd pass; on a limit* product grep 'tool-result snip' hits and grep -c 'batch read budget' = 0.

Phase 2 (A-2, work-group A memory fidelity). ALL in AlembicAgent repo; develop-on-main; LOCAL commit only, NO push. Authority = Design/docs/current/alembic-agent-cc-scratch-borrow-2026-07-01.md §8 Phase 2 (code-level target code given) + §3 A-2 + §6 + CG-1. Read parent CLAUDE.md + this state root + AlembicAgent CLAUDE.md, declare window/repo identity, claim ONLY this task. Phase 1+1b already accepted (commit 9bfa1dc) — do NOT touch ContextWindow.ts.

WORK (file src/agent/memory/MemoryRetriever.ts, render-only): add constants STALE_MEMORY_DAYS=7 + STALE_MEMORY_PREFIX='⏳[可能陈旧] ' (after SIMILARITY_UPDATE ~:31). Add a private static helper #stalenessPrefix(m: DeserializedMemory, now): compute age from CAMELCASE m.updatedAt (fallback m.lastAccessedAt), with an explicit Number.isNaN guard → return '' for invalid/missing timestamp (unknown-age = NOT annotated, no throw); ageDays > STALE_MEMORY_DAYS → return STALE_MEMORY_PREFIX else ''. In the toPromptSection line-builder (real anchor ~:226-236, NOT the stale :194), insert the prefix BETWEEN badge and [type]: `- ${badge} ${stale}[${m.type}] ${m.content}` so fresh memories (stale='') are byte-identical to before. CG-1 = FULL source: the builder change must cover both bootstrap (insightAnalyst.ts:390) and user (MemoryCoordinator.ts:798) recall paths.

CRITICAL TRAP (design §3/§8): builder input is the DESERIALIZED DeserializedMemory (camelCase updatedAt/lastAccessedAt from MemoryStore.deserialize ~:569-579); the raw rows at retrieve()/load() use snake_case (updated_at). Using snake_case m.updated_at → new Date(undefined) → NaN → age compare always false → EVERY memory silently un-annotated (phase ships as a no-op). Pin camelCase + Number.isNaN guard.

BOUNDARY / render-only: do NOT touch Core-owned semantic_memories schema (@alembic/core/memory), the raw-SQL sync adapter, or MemoryStore (SD-4 frozen rule MemoryStore.ts:14-26). No DB write — only renderer constants + a pure static fn + string interpolation.

ACCEPTANCE (design §8 Phase 2):
- git diff --stat = ONLY MemoryRetriever.ts + test/memory-context.test.ts; MemoryStore.ts/insightAnalyst.ts/Core schema/raw-SQL adapter ZERO change.
- npm run build:check (tsc) passes — misusing snake_case m.updated_at must fail the type gate (DeserializedMemory has no snake keys).
- 4 unit tests (test/memory-context.test.ts) GREEN, offline, fixtures built via the REAL store.add → deserialize path (NOT hand-built camelCase literals, so casing drift goes red), using a raw-row `UPDATE semantic_memories SET updated_at=?,last_accessed_at=? WHERE id=?` to age fixtures: (1) >7d → annotated; (2) ≤7d → NOT annotated; (3) missing/invalid timestamp → unknown-age NOT annotated (NaN guard); (4) updatedAt empty → falls back to lastAccessedAt via real deserialize. Note: MemoryRetriever is NOT exported from src/index.ts — import via '../src/agent/memory/MemoryRetriever.js' (grep-confirm first).
- Real bootstrap §8 prompt dump: corpus with known >7d AND ≤7d memories — grep -F '⏳[可能陈旧]' hits ≥ the stale count, each fresh line lacks the marker; attach underlying updatedAt values corroborating the age math (deterministic grep, NOT eyeball).
- FULL-source coverage: separately exercise the user-source recall path (MemoryCoordinator.ts:798) and grep the marker, proving the builder change covers ALL sources, not just bootstrap.

CROSS-PHASE HARD GATES (all required): offline `npm test`/vitest green (mock provider, NO real key); **PRODUCTION-FLOOR VERDICT BASELINE CAPTURE-THEN-DIFF on the FULL-source representative Recipe corpus** via test/recipe-authoring-inprocess-parity.test.ts — A-2 changes model-VISIBLE prompt text so this is the LOAD-BEARING gate (capture verdict JSON before, diff after, PASS = byte-empty diff; if a stale-bearing corpus shows prompt-text diff, confirm the floor verdict still does not drift); host-vs-in-process parity standing tripwire green.

FORBIDDEN: relaxing production floor / submit gate; touching Core schema / semantic_memories / raw-SQL adapter / MemoryStore (SD-4); any new LLM-callable tool or model round-trip; making the annotation anything other than render-only.

BACKFILL the TargetResultEnvelope: AlembicAgent commit hash (main), full vitest output, the §8 bootstrap dump + user-path dump with grep output + updatedAt corroboration, the FULL-source floor verdict baseline+diff JSON (the key A-2 evidence — must be byte-empty), residual risks, next step. If any hard gate (especially floor parity) cannot be met, STOP and return status=needs-review (NOT done) with the blocker.

Phase 3 (B-1, work-group B write safety) — the LAST phase. ALL in AlembicAgent repo; develop-on-main; LOCAL commit only, NO push. Authority = Design/docs/current/alembic-agent-cc-scratch-borrow-2026-07-01.md §8 Phase 3 (code-level target code given) + §3 B-1 + §6 + CG-3 + CG-4. Read parent CLAUDE.md + this state root + AlembicAgent CLAUDE.md, declare window/repo identity, claim ONLY this task. Phase 1+1b (9bfa1dc) and Phase 2 (0b1c029) already accepted — do NOT touch ContextWindow.ts / MemoryRetriever.ts.

PRE-CHECK (admission gate, design §3/§8): re-grep Core @alembic/core/io WriteZone for lastRead|mtime|hash|freshness|external — confirm Core provides NO read-before-write freshness primitive (design verified WriteZone is landing-point guard only). If Core DOES expose one, consume it instead of rebuilding and report. Provide the grep evidence in backfill.

WORK (file src/tools/runtime/handlers/code.ts ONLY; do NOT add a registry.ts field — CG-4): add `import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'`; add file-private freshnessFingerprint(content)=createHash('md5').update(content).digest('hex') (MUST align with DeltaCache's content-hash algorithm so 'disk content' vs 'cached read fingerprint' compare correctly — verify DeltaCache uses md5; if not, match whatever it uses); add a stable REREAD_GUIDANCE const (exact grep string per §8). In handleWrite, AFTER the PROTECTED_PATHS loop and BEFORE fs.writeFile, call `await checkWriteFreshness(resolved.absPath, resolved.relPath, ctx)` and return fail(freshness.error) on !ok; after a successful fs.writeFile, call `ctx.deltaCache?.set(resolved.relPath, freshnessFingerprint(content), content)` to update the baseline. Implement checkWriteFreshness with FOUR states, and CRITICALLY disk-existence takes precedence over cache-membership:
  state 4: fs.readFile(absPath) throws ENOENT → allow (new file);
  (deltaCache not injected → allow passthrough, don't false-reject legitimate writes);
  state 1: disk exists ∧ ctx.deltaCache.get(relPath) is undefined (not read this run) → REJECT 'code.write rejected: <relPath> exists on disk but was not read in this run. ' + REREAD_GUIDANCE;
  state 2 (CG-3): disk exists ∧ cached ∧ cached.hash !== freshnessFingerprint(diskContent) → REJECT 'code.write rejected: <relPath> changed externally since last read. ' + REREAD_GUIDANCE (hard reject, NOT silent overwrite, NOT log-only);
  state 3: disk exists ∧ cached ∧ hash matches → allow.
  Key on relPath (consistent with readSingleFile :459). The new-file branch keys on DISK existence, NOT cache membership — a disk-existing-but-unread file must hit state 1, never be waved through as 'new'.

SHARED-CTX HARD GATE (design §3/§8 — the make-or-break): read (handleRead/readSingleFile :458-459 writes the fingerprint via deltaCache.check) and write (checkWriteFreshness reads via deltaCache.get) MUST observe the SAME per-run ToolContext/deltaCache instance, which depends on the host's ToolContextFactory. This CANNOT be proven by a unit test hand-passing ctx. PROVE IT in a real run: instrument the factory-injected DeltaCache with a one-time #instanceId and log it from BOTH handleRead (after :459) and checkWriteFreshness (after get); dump the run, grep the two instanceId lines, assert EQUAL. If NOT equal (factory builds a fresh deltaCache per create()), B-1 is BLOCKED — return status=needs-review with the unequal-instanceId log and the message 'host factory does not share deltaCache at run scope'. Do NOT fake done; a non-shared ctx means the gate either false-rejects all legitimate rewrites or never fires.

UNIT TESTS (test/tool-v2-contract.test.ts) via router.execute({tool:'code',action:'read'|'write'}, ctx) (REAL routing path, not direct handleWrite), mkdtemp offline, 7 deterministic cases: (1) state4 new file (disk-absent) → ok===true + file on disk; (2) state1 disk-exists-but-unread (pre-write via fs without code.read) → ok===false + error contains 'exists on disk but was not read' + 'Re-read the file with code.read' (distinct from state4); (3) state3 read-then-consistent → ok===true; (4) state2 read-then-externally-modified (out-of-band fs.writeFile) → ok===false + 'changed externally since last read' + REREAD_GUIDANCE; (5) write-then-baseline-update (immediate same-ctx re-write, no external change) → ok===true (proves set() updated the fingerprint, no false-reject); (6) deltaCache-not-injected → ok===true passthrough; (7) shared-instance contract guard (same deltaCache passed twice → read then write hits state3; a DIFFERENT new DeltaCache passed to write → state1 reject), explicitly commented as logic-only, NOT a substitute for the real-run HARD GATE.

CROSS-PHASE HARD GATES: offline `npm test` / vitest green (mock provider, NO real key); Phase 3 ALSO build/typecheck + lint:core-import-boundary green; production-floor verdict baseline capture-then-diff (B-1 doesn't touch prompt text → expect byte-empty, but produce the diff as a regression tripwire); host-vs-in-process parity standing tripwire green.

FORBIDDEN: relaxing production floor / submit gate; touching ToolResult{ok,data,error,_meta} envelope, {tool,action} naming, code.write spec (concurrency/risk), or ok()/fail(); adding a registry.ts/ToolContext field (CG-4 = reuse deltaCache); any new LLM-callable tool or model round-trip.

BACKFILL the TargetResultEnvelope: AlembicAgent commit hash (main), WriteZone grep evidence, full vitest output, the SHARED-CTX instanceId real-run log (two equal lines — the HARD GATE evidence), the first-write-new-file positive call-scoped assertion (ok ∧ data.written ∧ disk==written), the changed-externally reject envelope dump (+ disk not overwritten), floor verdict baseline+diff JSON, residual risks, next step. If the shared-ctx HARD GATE fails OR any other hard gate cannot be met, STOP and return status=needs-review (NOT done / NOT a workaround) with the blocker + instanceId evidence.
